# FitPulse — Data Dictionary

**File:** `data/raw/fitpulse_raw.csv` (Bronze layer)
**Rows:** 100,122 · **Users:** 437 · **Date range:** 2024-01-01 to 2024-12-25
**Generated by:** `data/prepare_raw_dataset.py`, from Kaggle dataset
`jijagallery/fitlife-health-and-fitness-tracking-dataset` (see `viva.md` for why this
source was used instead of a "real" wearable dataset).

## Columns present in the raw (Bronze) file

| Column | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `user_id` | int | Unique participant identifier |
| `date` | date | Calendar day this row's metrics were logged |
| `steps` | int | Total steps recorded that day |
| `calories_burned` | float | Kcal burned during the day's logged activity session (recomputed via the MET formula — see `viva.md`) |
| `distance_km` | float | Distance covered, derived from steps × height-based stride length |
| `active_minutes` | int | Minutes spent in the day's logged activity session |
| `sedentary_minutes` | int | Minutes not spent sleeping or active (1440 − sleep − active) |
| `resting_heart_rate` | float | Resting heart rate (bpm) |
| `avg_heart_rate` | int | Average heart rate during the logged activity (bpm) |
| `max_heart_rate` | int | Peak heart rate during the logged activity (bpm), capped at the age-predicted max (220 − age) |
| `sleep_minutes` | int | Minutes slept that night |
| `sleep_quality_score` | float | 0–100 score, deterministically derived from sleep duration, stress level, and resting heart rate (see `data/prepare_raw_dataset.py`) |
| `activity_type` | string | One of: Walking, Running, Cycling, Swimming, Yoga, Weight Training, HIIT, Dancing, Basketball, Tennis |
| `intensity` | string | Low / Medium / High |
| `age` | int | Participant age (18–64) |
| `gender` | string | F / M / Other |
| `height_cm` | float | Height in centimeters |
| `weight_kg` | float | Weight in kilograms |
| `bmi` | float | Body Mass Index |
| `health_condition` | string | None / Hypertension / Diabetes / Asthma |
| `smoking_status` | string | Never / Former / Current |
| `stress_level` | int | Self-reported daily stress, 1–10 |
| `hydration_level` | float | Liters of water consumed that day |

## Columns ADDED during Spark ETL (Silver layer — `data/processed/fitpulse_silver/`)

These do **not** exist in the raw file — they are engineered by `etl/spark_etl.py`:

| Column | Description |
|---|---|
| `day_of_week` | Monday … Sunday |
| `month` | `yyyy-MM`, also the Parquet partition key |
| `is_rest_day` | 1 if `active_minutes` < 15 (note: this dataset has no true zero-activity days — every row has a logged session — so this flag is currently always 0; kept in the schema for when real intraday data without a forced daily session is used) |
| `steps_lag1` / `steps_lag2` / `steps_lag7` | That user's steps 1/2/7 days ago |
| `calories_lag1` | That user's calories burned 1 day ago |
| `sleep_quality_lag1` | That user's sleep quality score 1 day ago |
| `steps_roll7_avg` | That user's trailing 7-day average steps |
| `calories_roll7_avg` | Trailing 7-day average calories burned |
| `active_minutes_roll7_avg` | Trailing 7-day average active minutes |
| `resting_hr_roll7_avg` | Trailing 7-day average resting heart rate |
| `daily_step_goal` | Personalized goal = 1.10 × that user's own yearly average steps |
| `daily_calorie_goal` | Personalized goal = 1.10 × that user's own yearly average calories burned |
| `goal_achieved` | 1 if `steps` ≥ `daily_step_goal` |
| `calorie_goal_achieved` | 1 if `calories_burned` ≥ `daily_calorie_goal` |

## Gold layer (`data/population_stats/user_percentiles.parquet`)

One row per user: `user_id`, `age_group`, `gender`, `avg_steps`, `avg_calories_burned`,
`avg_sleep_quality`, `goal_achievement_rate_pct`, `steps_percentile`,
`calories_percentile`, `sleep_quality_percentile` — produced by `etl/spark_benchmarks.py`.
